Content: :ibox:`bbtext(This problem has two parts.)`
How does meeting the ice lynx affect Mira's behavior in the excerpt from “Mira on the Ice”?

A.Choice: She realizes the danger she was in and focuses on the task of collecting bugs.

B.Choice: She decides to stop exploring and wonders whether her discovery was real.

C.Choice: She questions her skills in contributing specimens to the collection survey.

B.Choice: “'Collection isn't as easy as it looks! But you'll get the hang of it.'” (paragraph `23`)

Content: :ibox:`bbtext(This problem has two parts.)`

Content: :ibox:`bbtext(This problem has two parts.)`
Which statement `bbtext(best)` describes how the text structure of the excerpts from “Mira on the Ice” and “The Beadwork” contribute to their meaning?

A.Choice: A problem-and-solution structure is used in “Mira on the Ice” to detail Mira's encounter with the storm, while a descriptive structure is used in “The Beadwork” to emphasize the setting.

Content: Which sentences from the stories `bbtext(best)` support the answer to Part A? Select `text(one)` answer from `bbtext(each)` story for a total of `bbtext(two)` correct answers.

A.Choice: “Through the haze of smoke belching from the barge's stacks, she saw the jagged white shore glistening in the morning light.” (paragraph `1`, “Mira on the Ice”)

C.Choice: “Then she found the nearest crevice, knelt down, and gently emptied the contents of her jars into the ice with sure, steady hands.” (paragraph `24`, “Mira on the Ice”)

E.Choice: “After some experience I usually drew easy and simple crosses and squares.” (paragraph `5`, “The Beadwork”)

F.Choice: “The quietness of her oversight made me feel strongly responsible and dependent upon my own judgment.” (paragraph `5`, “The Beadwork”)

Content: You have read the excerpts from “Mira on the Ice” and “The Beadwork.” Both stories depict girls facing challenges while interacting with family members.
